title: Rung 1: LLVM18-compatible Rust and Julia frontends required
description:
The requested dual-major scalar rung includes Rust and Julia on LLVM18, never an omitted language. Installed rustc 1.99.1 emits LLVM23.1.1; Julia 1.13.3 code_llvm emits LLVM20.1.8. All source native O0/O2 oracles compile/run, but LLVM18 cannot read their current stock IR. Dialect @023f5a7 §19.8: "An input newer than M is BD-E-VERSION." This is a toolchain prerequisite, not an illegal scalar or a plugin refusal. Install and publish compatible stock Rust/Julia frontends that emit LLVM<=18 and fit the legality envelope, with explicit paths/version recording; otherwise coordinate the frontend/major matrix with the dialect owner. Do not rewrite/downgrade IR, drop languages or count this as a skip. Reproduce commands:

title: Rung 1: exhaustive ordinary scalar C Rust Julia gate
description: Implement North Star §8 rung 1 without narrowing dialect §5.1 part 1. Both LLVM majors, ordinary marker-free scalar corpus, O0/O2 native oracles, both executors, full Int8 products, zero faults and byte-exact reversal. Record real evidence and owning-repository blockers.

title: Rung 3: musl hello-world reversible console, reset and tape replay gate
description: Implement the full North Star §8 rung 3 gate for ordinary musl hello.c on LLVM 18/23, dialect 0.2.10 @023f5a7 and ISA 0.8. Native comparison must use materialised runtimes/arith code (never host libc). Require R console, whole-run reset, deterministic tape replay on both executors. File measured upstream blockers without narrowing scope. Gate implementation completion is distinct from rung acceptance.
notes: Gate implementation and recorded LLVM 18/23 run complete, full acceptance remains blocked. RESULTS.md and .tmp/rung-3/20261101T125405.461872Z/ carry the table and exact evidence. Ordered upstream prerequisites: brt-1ft, brt-cgb, bp-ivy, bennett-driver-cyg, b-isa-spec-221, b-isa-spec-04d, bennett-vm-u8m. Ordinary musl hello.c fails on missing stdio.h; all required downstream stages are BLOCKED. Published device/reset controls pass on both executors but do not establish hello-world or tape-consuming replay. Eight gate tests, rung-2 five tests/AST identity, checker 2, clauses 113, suite 23 and neutral 16/16 pass. No sibling source changes, no push, no Dolt sync.

title: Accept audited two-stage native comparison adapter and select LLVM major in driver probe
description: bennett-driver-cyg implements --bennett-materialised/--bennett-comparison-record/output. Audited native record has bitcode_link_argv (llvm-link device.bc runtime.bc arith.bc --only-needed) and link_argv (clang same-major comparison-linked.bc and explicit native support). Direct clang of all three .bc files creates duplicate strong definitions because device.bc already links needed runtime functions; merged --only-needed preserves actual device input/hash and runtime/arith pin hashes. §19.5 layout requires an auditable linker script/map; gate whitelist currently rejects -Wl,-T, --fatal-warnings/--no-undefined and expects library paths directly in final link argv. Needed equivalent consumer adapter validating bitcode_link_argv, linked/materialised/library hashes and script/map instead of weakening no-libc checks. Also driver_probe omits --bennett-llvm-major so both gates choose newest envelope major23 by §19.8 default; pass explicit m for per-major receipts. All full R/native prerequisites remain blocked (bp-xkg, plugin comparison bead, brt-nuu); no gate or fixture narrowed.
